headline: BOJ Governor Ueda Says AI Can Help Ease Japan's Labor Shortages
summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda stated that rapid advancements in artificial intelligence provide a positive demand shock for the Japanese economy, though supply-side factors require study.
why: Comments from central bank leaders on technological productivity and labor shocks offer perspective on long-term economic potential and monetary policy trajectories.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Technological integration addresses demographic labor shortages, influencing long-term GDP growth.
